newsitem.title: USA: FDA extends comment period on fresh juices.
newsitem.headline: FDA extends comment period on fresh juices.

text.p: The Food and Drug Administration Thursday said it was extending the comment period for its review of the current science and technology on fresh juices until Feb. 3 in response to several requests.

The agency has asked for information on fresh juice manufacturing and held a two-day hearing last month in the wake of a recent outbreak of E.coli 0157:H7, a pathogen, in unpastuerized apple juice in the West that killed a child.
An FDA official said at the meeting regulators would decide in the first quarter of 1997 whether additional steps were needed to assure juices were safe to drink.
